response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which at priority 90 dominates the out-of-window ineligibility rule RET-008 (priority 10). Final-sale rule RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False. Thus the defective item is eligible regardless of the 48-day elapsed window.
